problem: Native style, rich-string and merge rows lacked operation assertions. A supported alignment edit of excel-values-formulas-chart.xls appended a 70th XF but retained XFCRC.cxfs=69, causing commit readback to fail with InvalidRecord(0x087c). The fresh XLS writer also emitted a fixed checksum unrelated to its actual XF payloads.
changes: Update an existing XFCRC count and actual MS-OSHARED checksum after XF insertion/removal, preserving its header/reserved bytes and all native XFExt records. Validate the source checksum before the edit and refuse a stale one rather than falsely validating its retained extensions. Enforce the 4050-XF limit before mutation.
Replace the fresh writer constant checksum with a checksum over the actual emitted 20-byte XF payloads, excluding BIFF record headers.

Add eleven semantic native tests across XLS/XLSX/XLSB for style resolution, rich runs, merge reads/lifecycle, supported publication and precise preservation/inverse scopes. Add an independent checksum regression for fresh output and a unit regression for stale-source/limit refusals.
Map nine additional feature rows to partial native assertions; clarify XLS merge editing and palette-based FormatChange limits in the existing feature matrix.

verification_scope.xls_styles: Sheet2 A1:C1 and Native workbook summary anchor; Aptos Narrow 12pt bold/center. Native formats B13/C13=14, B14=18, C14=21, B15=9, C15=10, and B20 quote-prefixed 00123. Shared rich text has UTF-16 boundaries 14/18/19 and logical font IDs 8/0/7; index 4 is reserved.
verification_scope.xls_publication: Sheet2 A2 right/wrap edit has an independently verified 69-to-70 XF summary; native checksum is 0x82cdd373. Original XF payload prefix and all XFExt bytes remain exact; all ordinary-sheet values/formulas, merges, fonts and other CFB streams are retained. File save/reopen and byte-exact source inverse pass.
verification_scope.xls_checksum: Oracle uses an independent bit-at-a-time MS-OSHARED 2.4.3 computation. Fresh 21-XF and 22-XF outputs with extensions verify against it. The unit test proves a stale CRC and a 4051st XF refuse before mutating the stream. Normative local research: MS-XLS 2.4.354 and MS-OSHARED 2.4.3; no runtime spec or 3rdparty dependency.
verification_scope.xlsx_styles_rich_text: Native local font/alignment/date/percentage/quote-prefix semantics and four rich runs are asserted. The unformatted prefix is distinguished from explicit Aptos Narrow 12pt run properties. Editing bold to BOLD retains the complete rich model; calculation-chain removal, manifest updates and dirty calculation properties follow the existing value-edit contract. All unrelated members are exact; reopened inverse permits only semantically identical workbook relationship reserialization.
verification_scope.xlsx_merges: Remove native Sheet2 A1:C1, create A10:C10, save/reopen and invert. Anchor value is retained; sheet2.xml is the only changed part and inverse restores all original member bytes.
verification_scope.xlsb_styles_rich_text: Binary style font/alignment and six number-format IDs are asserted. Shared-string offsets 14/18/19 map to font IDs 4/0/3. The inline rich-string setter refuses a native shared-string cell with UnsupportedContent and a no-op commit. Supported native A2-to-Z100 copy retains all typed shared strings and fonts, changes only sharedStrings.bin, sheet1.bin and binaryIndex1.bin, and inverts byte-exactly after file publication.
verification_scope.xlsb_merges: Remove native Sheet2 A1:C1, create A10:C10, and refuse an overlapping rectangle with InvalidValue. Only sheet2.bin changes; every non-MERGE_CELL binary record remains exact. File save/reopen and exact source inverse pass.
verification_scope.limits: No native Office reopen, rendering, recalculation, macro/control execution or external refresh occurred. XLS source-bound add_merged_cells is create-only and precisely refuses mutation. FormatChange continues to clear fHasXFExt on its new palette-based XF; retained source extension records are not cloned onto that style, so extension/theme appearance fidelity is not claimed. XLS rich strings are read-only in this batch. Other palette/theme, phonetic, inline-rich and cross-workbook transfer cases remain open.
